question:
The following line graph shows the annual profit percentage earned by a company during the years 2016 to 2020.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fc40282c84a161d9bde376dd5d17e459fe34deec9596a55161d3ee97a67c84b.png] 

What is the average profit percent earned by the company during the years 2016 to 2020 ?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Profit percent earned by the company during the years 2016 to 2020 = 45 + 70 + 60 + 40 + 55 = 270

Average profit percent earned by the company during the years 2016 to 2020 = 270/5

⇒ 54%

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
